svg.title: Episode 01: phishMe
svg.desc: phishMe, the case of the too-perfect benchmark. A leakage-aware phishing detection pipeline: 46,786 de-duplicated rows split 28,068 / 9,356 / 9,362, disjoint by registrable domain, paired bootstrap with 10,000 resamples, and a linear model that runs on-device in a Chrome extension under 25 MB and 250 ms p95. Art: a fishing hook dangles a fake login card and a red stamp slams down: phish, 0.94.

g.text: IN: THE CASE OF THE TOO-PERFECT BENCHMARK
A phishing model aced its own benchmark. Our hero asked:
does it still work on data it has never seen? A leakage-aware
pipeline, plus a linear model that scores on-device in Chrome.
don't generalize yet. To be continued...
